meta.source: research round 2026-09-09 (round 35) — Shandong yearbook wired; Henan blocked
meta.note: Wires the Shandong Statistical Yearbook 2025 off its per-chapter 简要说明, and records Henan as blocked. NO NODES MINTED — this is pure wiring, as the round was scoped. THE METHOD FINDING, which contradicts what the round was told to expect: Shandong's chapter notes are NOT the Jiangsu/Guangdong template. The handoff said 建筑业 and 农业 'have named an NBS 统计报表制度 by title in every yearbook checked so far' and sent this round to open those two first — in Shandong BOTH are agency-level and name no instrument. 建筑业 (sm15) says only 本篇资料来源于建筑业统计年报，由省统计局投资处整理提供 — a generic report description plus an internal division, the ordinary §7a refusal; 农业 (sm13) names five provincial DEPARTMENTS (自然资源厅, 农业农村厅, 水利厅, 山东调查总队) and 农村综合统计年报, again no titled instrument. All 25 chapter notes were fetched and swept for 《…》 rather than sampled, and only FOUR chapters name a titled artefact at all: sm04, sm18, sm23 and sm24. So the productive chapter varies by province and the two-chapter shortcut should not be trusted as a starting rule — sweep all the notes, it is one fetch each. SHAPE: Shandong is a fourth physical shape, not one of round 31's four. Its tables are 387 .jpg scans with no text layer (unreadable, and irrelevant), but its 25 chapter notes are separate single-page TEXT PDFs at html/smNN.pdf with embedded Identity-H CID fonts — so the yearbook is image-only and text-bearing at the same time, depending which part you ask for. Its 编辑说明 is html/note.jpg, an image, and is therefore refused the way Suzhou's was. Frameset at tjnj/nj2025/zk/indexch.htm, TOC at left.htm, reachable over HTTP ONLY (https is connection-refused).

dependencies.basis: SELF-DECLARED: chapter 4 (就业、工资和社会保障) of the Shandong Statistical Yearbook 2025's own 简要说明 states under 二、本篇资料的来源 that the chapter's employment, total-wage and average-wage data are taken from the NBS instrument, naming it by title: 就业基本情况及分组资料、工资总额、平均工资等资料取自《劳动工资统计报表制度》。 The yearbook's own English rendering of the same sentence reads 'are collected and compiled through The Reporting Form System on Labour Wage Statistics', which confirms the reading. QUOTE CUT: the sentence is split across the page's two columns — plain `pdftotext` returns 等资料取自《劳动工资统计报表制度》 as one contiguous line while `-layout` puts the first half in the left column — so the stored quote is the contiguous right-column span, which carries both the dependency verb (取自) and the artefact's full title. Verified by code point: standard CJK book-title marks U+300A/U+300B, 17 characters. Read live from the cited URL on 2026-09-09 from the cloud container.
dependencies.evidence_quote: 等资料取自《劳动工资统计报表制度》

_dropped.why: REFUSED 2026-09-09. Chapter 15 建筑业 was the chapter the round was told to open first, on the expectation that every yearbook names 《建筑业统计报表制度》 there. Shandong does not. Its whole source clause is 本篇资料来源于建筑业统计年报，由省统计局投资处整理提供 — 建筑业统计年报 is a generic description of an annual return, not the instrument's title, and 投资处 is an internal division of the bureau. Agency-not-artefact, §7a, and the ordinary refusal. Recorded rather than left silent so the next Shandong round does not re-open sm15.

REFUSED 2026-09-09. Chapter 13 农业, the round's other named starting point. Its 简要说明 attributes five separate data classes to provincial DEPARTMENTS (省自然资源厅, 省农业农村厅, 省水利厅) and to 国家统计局山东调查总队, and the residual clause is 其余资料来源于农村综合统计年报 — again a generic annual-return description, no titled instrument anywhere in the chapter. Agency-not-artefact, §7a.

RESOLVED 2026-09-09 (round 40) — BOTH instruments now have nodes and BOTH edges are live in cn-round40-2026-09-09.json. This entry called the citation 'the strongest this round found and cannot be used', and it was right on both counts; what was missing was a page for either instrument. Round 40 found both in the Shanghai bureau's 年定报制度目录 (entries 5 and 7), each with a first-party PDF whose cover reads 国家统计局制定 / 上海市统计局补充、印制. Thomas ruled 2026-09-09: mint both off that edition, on rule 19's principle that authorship decides the publisher, not the host. No NBS-HOSTED page for either has ever been found, and round 40 did not find one — both nodes carry that caveat and their URLs should move if one turns up. This makes Shandong one of four yearbooks wired to the pair, with Guangdong (CD zip, not opened) and Jiangsu ch14 still available as further edges. Original entry follows, untouched. --- [deferred] NOT WIRED for want of a target node, 2026-09-09. Chapter 18 names BOTH missing instruments by title in one sentence — 本篇资料是根据《批发和零售业统计报表制度》、《住宿和餐饮业统计报表制度》进行搜集和加工整理而得 — which is the strongest citation this round found and cannot be used. These two are the standing parked lead: named by the national yearbook, by Guangdong, and now by Shandong, but NBS's 统计制度 listing has no page for either and round 30's article-id probe (range 1962929-1962952) did not turn them up. **Shandong is the third independent yearbook to name them, which strengthens the case for hunting the pages again rather than the case for minting without one.** Same entry covers 《住宿和餐饮业统计报表制度》.

NOT WIRED for want of a target node, 2026-09-09. Chapter 23 (各省主要经济指标) states 本篇资料来源于中国统计出版社出版的《中国统计摘要 2025》 — naming the China Statistical Abstract by title, WITH an edition year and its publisher (中国统计出版社), which is more than the national and Guangdong yearbooks gave when this lead was first parked in rounds 29-30. No node exists and no stats.gov.cn page has been found for it. Chapter 24 names 《国际统计年鉴 2024》 (International Statistical Yearbook, same publisher) on the same pattern — also nodeless, and not separately listed here because it is the same class of refusal.

NOT ATTEMPTED — host blocked, 2026-09-09. Henan was the round's second target. `tjj.henan.gov.cn` returns 403 to the cloud container, 403 over BOTH http and https from the device VM, and serves Thomas's own Chrome a 'Sorry, you have been blocked' interstitial naming the requesting IP — so the block is on the address, the Shenzhen shape, not on the user-agent. Sub-paths are blocked identically (`/tjnj/`, `/tjfw/tjnj/`, a guessed frameset path), so this is not a root-only rule. Three routes, one day, one machine each: the tracker's own bar for recording a host as blocked was met rather than assumed. Checked for an alternate host on NBS's own 地方统计网站 portal — it lists only `tjj.henan.gov.cn` for the bureau plus `hazd.stats.gov.cn` for the separate NBS survey office in Henan, which is a different body and returned 503. Re-probe before believing this.
